<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>JasmineClosette | Chat on WhatsApp</title>
<meta name="description" content="Women’s outfits styled and modelled by Jasmine. Chat with her on WhatsApp for prices, sizes and delivery.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:wght@700;800&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<!-- TikTok Pixel: replace YOUR_PIXEL_ID with the Pixel ID from TikTok Events Manager -->
<script>
!function (w, d, t) {
  w.TiktokAnalyticsObject=t;var ttq=w[t]=w[t]||[];ttq.methods=["page","track","identify","instances","debug","on","off","once","ready","alias","group","enableCookie","disableCookie"],ttq.setAndDefer=function(t,e){t[e]=function(){t.push([e].concat(Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments,0)))}};for(var i=0;i<ttq.methods.length;i++)ttq.setAndDefer(ttq,ttq.methods[i]);ttq.instance=function(t){for(var e=ttq._i[t]||[],n=0;n<ttq.methods.length;n++)ttq.setAndDefer(e,ttq.methods[n]);return e},ttq.load=function(e,n){var i="https://analytics.tiktok.com/i18n/pixel/events.js";ttq._i=ttq._i||{},ttq._i[e]=[],ttq._i[e]._u=i,ttq._t=ttq._t||{},ttq._t[e]=+new Date,ttq._o=ttq._o||{},ttq._o[e]=n||{};var o=document.createElement("script");o.type="text/javascript",o.async=!0,o.src=i+"?sdkid="+e+"&lib="+t;var a=document.getElementsByTagName("script")[0];a.parentNode.insertBefore(o,a)};
  ttq.load('YOUR_PIXEL_ID');
  ttq.page();
}(window, document, 'ttq');
</script>

<style>
:root{--navy:#10142e;--navy2:#1b2150;--rose:#e0325f;--cream:#fff4ee;--muted:#b9bcd6;--wa:#25d366;--wa2:#1fb957}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{margin:0;background:var(--navy)}
body{color:var(--cream);font-family:"DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif;line-height:1.5;padding:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) 0 env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
.page{position:relative;max-width:460px;margin:0 auto;padding:16px 20px 28px;min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}
.glow{position:absolute;inset:-40px -60px auto -60px;height:520px;background:url(data:image/jpeg;base64,) center/cover;filter:blur(38px) saturate(1.3);opacity:.5;z-index:0}
.glow::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(16,20,46,.1),var(--navy) 92%)}
.page>*:not(.glow){position:relative;z-index:1}

.logo{font-family:"Bricolage Grotesque",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:1.15rem;text-align:center;letter-spacing:.01em;margin:0 0 16px}
.logo span{color:var(--rose)}

.frame{width:min(54vw,224px);aspect-ratio:247/331;margin:0 auto;border-radius:999px 999px 20px 20px;overflow:hidden;
  border:3px solid rgba(255,244,238,.9);box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgba(224,50,95,.35),0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.4);background:var(--navy2)}
.frame img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}

h1{font-family:"Bricolage Grotesque",sans-serif;font-weight:800;text-align:center;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,8.4vw,2.3rem);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.015em;margin:22px 0 8px}
.sub{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:1rem;margin:0 0 20px}

.btn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;width:100%;min-height:64px;background:var(--wa);color:#08210f;
  text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;font-size:1.15rem;border-radius:18px;padding:14px 20px;box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(37,211,102,.35)}
.btn:active{background:var(--wa2);transform:scale(.99)}
.btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--cream);outline-offset:3px}
.btn svg{width:26px;height:26px;fill:none;stroke:#08210f;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none}
.hint{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:.86rem;margin:10px 0 0}

.how{margin:28px 0 0;padding:20px 0 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,244,238,.14);display:grid;gap:14px}
.how div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:34px 1fr;gap:12px;align-items:center}
.how b{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--rose);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:"Bricolage Grotesque",sans-serif}

footer{margin-top:auto;padding-top:26px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted)S;font-size:.82rem}

.bar{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:5;padding:10px 16px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));
  background:rgba(16,20,46,.96);border-top:1px solid rgba(255,244,238,.14);transform:translateY(110%);transition:transform .25s}
.bar.show{transform:none}
.bar .btn{max-width:428px;margin:0 auto;min-height:56px}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.bar{transition:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="page">
  <div class="glow" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="logo">Jasmine<span>Closette</span></div>

  <div class="frame"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Navy and red floral two-piece outfit with ruffled skirt" width="494" height="662"></div>

  <h1>Love this outfit? Ask Jasmine on WhatsApp</h1>
  <p class="sub">Get the price, sizes, colours and delivery in one chat.</p>

  <a id="main-btn" class="btn wa" href="#" data-where="main">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 11.5a8.5 8.5 0 0 1-12.5 7.5L3 20.5l1.6-5A8.5 8.5 0 1 1 21 11.5z"/><path d="M9 9.5c0 3 2.5 5.5 5.5 5.5l1.5-1.5-2-1-1 .8a4 4 0 0 1-1.8-1.8l.8-1-1-2z"/></svg>
    Chat on WhatsApp
  </a>
  <p class="hint">Opens WhatsApp with your message ready to send</p>

  <div class="how">
    <div><b>1</b><span>Tap the button and send the message</span></div>
    <div><b>2</b><span>Tell Jasmine which outfit you saw</span></div>
    <div><b>3</b><span>She replies with details so you can order</span></div>
  </div>

  <footer>&copy; JasmineClosette &middot; Orders handled on WhatsApp</footer>
</div>

<div class="bar" id="bar"><a class="btn wa" href="#" data-where="sticky">Chat on WhatsApp</a></div>
<script>
(function () {
  var url = "https://wa.me/2348166892933?text=" + encodeURIComponent("Hi Jasmine, I saw your outfit on TikTok and I’d like to ask about it.");
  document.querySelectorAll(".wa").forEach(function (a) {
    a.href = url; a.target = "_blank"; a.rel = "noopener";
    a.addEventListener("click", function () {
      try { if (window.ttq) ttq.track("Contact", { content_name: "WhatsApp click", description: a.getAttribute("data-where") }); } catch (e) {}
    });
  });
  var main = document.getElementById("main-btn"), bar = document.getElementById("bar");
  if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
    new IntersectionObserver(function (e) { bar.classList.toggle("show", !e[0].isIntersecting); }).observe(main);
  }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
